Metadata.title: UnderwriteAI — Underwriting intelligence for AI risk
Metadata.description: UnderwriteAI helps insurers measure and price the risk of their clients' AI systems — without needing the source code.

footer.tagline: Underwriting intelligence for AI risk. We help insurers measure and price the risk of their clients' AI systems.

landing.headline: We help insurers cover the risks of AI.
landing.subhead: Every company is racing to use AI. Almost no one is insuring what could go wrong. We give insurers a clear risk score for their clients' AI.
landing.gapTitle: AI is everywhere. So are its mistakes.
landing.howSubtitle: Three steps. No source code required.
landing.howFooter: More evidence, less guessing. We reduce uncertainty — the insurer still sets the final price.
landing.ctaTitle: Insurers price fire, floods and cyber. We help them price AI.

s1.label: of companies now use AI in at least one function

ask.title: Ask
ask.body: The client declares how their AI is used: what it does, what data it touches, and who reviews it.

test.title: Test
test.body: Two AI agents probe the system — one tries to break it, one grades the answers for leaks, injection and unsafe advice.

score.title: Score
score.body: We combine disclosures and test results into one clear risk score — with findings and recommended conditions.

about.storyIntro: A story every insurer will soon recognise.
about.step1Body: UnderwriteAI launches an AI chatbot to advise customers on financial products. Adoption is fast. Everyone is happy. The future looks bright.
about.step2Body: The chatbot confidently gives wrong financial advice. Worse, it leaks a customer's private data. What seemed like innovation becomes a liability.
about.step3Body: The customer sues. The regulator investigates. UnderwriteAI is on the hook. And the question nobody prepared for appears: "Who pays?"
about.problemTitle: Insurers want to cover this. But they can't measure it.
about.gap1Body: Clients won't share their models or source code. Traditional audits don't apply.
about.gap2Body: Insurers have no repeatable way to judge how risky an AI system really is.
about.gap3Title: So they say no — or guess
about.gap3Body: Either AI risk is refused, or priced blindly. Both cost the insurer.
about.solutionTitle: UnderwriteAI is an X-ray for AI risk.
about.solutionBody: We give insurers a clear risk score for their clients' AI — without ever needing the secret code.
about.solutionFooter: We don't sell insurance. We help insurers sell it smarter.
about.sample1: Prompt injection bypassed the chatbot guardrails.
about.sample2: Leaked sample personal data in 2 of 50 test prompts.
about.sample3: Confident wrong advice on regulated topics.

assessment.useCasePlaceholder: e.g. Customer-facing chatbot for financial advice
assessment.confidential: Generated by UnderwriteAI · Confidential — for underwriting use only
assessment.premiumFactorNote: Premium factor: indicative — not actuarial (1.00x + score/100 × 1.50).
assessment.premiumFactorExplain: Premium factor uses a simple rule: 1.00x + (score ÷ 100) × 1.50 (range 1.00x–2.50x). For underwriting judgement only — not an actuarial rate.
assessment.topDrivers: Top drivers of the {tier} rating — from disclosures
assessment.howAskBody: Client disclosures on use, data and controls.
assessment.howTestBody: Attack agent probed the system; judge agent graded every response.
assessment.howScoreBody: Disclosures and test results combined into one risk score.
assessment.disclaimer: Risk score and premium factor are indicative — not actuarial. They support underwriting judgement; they do not replace it.
assessment.tierMessageHigh: Coverage should be declined or repriced until the high-severity findings are remediated.
assessment.tierMessageMedium: Coverage is feasible with the conditions below attached to the policy.
assessment.tierMessageLow: Standard coverage is appropriate. Maintain controls and re-assess at renewal.

systemStatus.title: What is the status of this AI system?
systemStatus.help: Live systems create immediate underwriting exposure.

useCase.title: What is the primary use case?
useCase.help: Higher-stakes decisions carry more potential liability.

actionableAdvice.title: Can the AI give advice that users may act on?
actionableAdvice.help: Actionable guidance creates advice and errors & omissions exposure.

options.yes: Yes — users may rely on it

autonomousActions.title: Can it trigger actions without a human?
autonomousActions.help: Payments, approvals, account changes, or access blocking raise severity.

options.yes: Yes — it can act on its own

financialImpact.title: Worst-case financial impact if it fails?
financialImpact.help: Sets the order of magnitude for potential claims.

nonFinancialImpact.title: What is the main non-financial risk if it fails?
nonFinancialImpact.help: Regulatory, privacy, and safety failures drive liability and reputation loss.

modelSource.title: Where does the model come from?
modelSource.help: Provider and hosting affect control surface and vendor risk.

options.major: Major provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure)

vendorContract.title: Is there a vendor contract covering AI liability and data use?
vendorContract.help: Contractual allocation of risk matters at claim time.

options.yes: Yes — liability, data use, and incident notice covered

dataSensitivity.title: What is the most sensitive data it processes?
dataSensitivity.help: Sensitive data raises the cost of a leak or misuse.

dataHandling.title: How are prompts and outputs handled?
dataHandling.help: Storage, training use, and third-party sharing affect privacy exposure.

options.minimal: Not stored; not used for training; not shared
options.stored: Stored for operations; not used for training

piiFiltering.title: Is PII filtered on input and scanned on output?
piiFiltering.help: Reduces leakage of personal data through the model.

options.yes: Yes — both input filtering and output scanning

humanOversight.title: Is a human reviewing high-impact AI output?
humanOversight.help: Human review is the strongest control against AI mistakes.

options.always: Always — before high-impact actions or regulated advice
options.never: Never — the AI acts without human review

guardrails.title: Which technical protections are in place?
guardrails.help: Injection defenses, content filters, and access controls reduce technical risk.

options.full: Injection defenses, content filters, and auth/rate limits

logging.title: Are prompts, outputs, and tool calls logged?
logging.help: Logs make claims defensible and incidents traceable.

options.full: Yes — enough to reconstruct a claim, with retention

incidentResponse.title: Is there a documented incident response for AI failures?
incidentResponse.help: Insurers need a clear path when something goes wrong.

options.yes: Yes — process and notification SLA defined

sandboxAccess.title: Is a sandbox / staging API available for insurer testing?
sandboxAccess.help: Required for automated red-teaming without source code access.

frameworks.title: Which governance frameworks do you map to?
frameworks.help: Shows alignment with emerging AI and data protection expectations.

options.multiple: EU AI Act / GDPR / sector rules (or equivalent) documented

aiPolicy.title: Is there a written AI governance policy approved by management?

qualityMeasurement.title: Do you measure output quality and track known failure modes?
qualityMeasurement.help: Accuracy monitoring reduces hallucination and advice liability.

options.yes: Yes — metrics and known failure modes documented

retestOnChange.title: Do you re-test after model, prompt, or tool changes?
retestOnChange.help: Change control prevents silent risk increases between renewals.

priorIncidents.title: Any prior AI-related loss, complaint, or regulatory action?
priorIncidents.help: Prior losses are a direct underwriting signal.

options.minor: Yes — minor / remediated, no material loss
options.yes: Yes — material loss, open dispute, or regulatory action

existingCover.title: Is there existing cyber / tech E&O / PI cover that may overlap?
existingCover.help: Helps underwriters avoid double-counting and spot AI exclusions.

options.yes_ai: Yes — and AI is not excluded
options.yes_excluded: Yes — but AI risk is excluded or unclear

redTeamed.title: Has the system been independently red-teamed for AI risks?
redTeamed.help: External testing evidence strengthens the technical risk score.

options.older: Yes — but more than 12 months ago

userDisclosure.title: Are users told they are interacting with AI?
userDisclosure.help: Transparency reduces surprise and complaint risk.

attestation.title: Do you attest that these answers are complete and accurate?
attestation.help: Material misrepresentation may affect coverage at claim or renewal. You authorize agreed sandbox testing.

options.yes: Yes — I confirm and authorize agreed testing
options.no: No — I cannot attest at this time

disclosure_not_attested.title: Disclosure not attested
disclosure_not_attested.detail: The applicant did not attest to accuracy. Coverage should not be bound without a signed attestation.

no_human_in_loop.title: No human in the loop on consequential actions
no_human_in_loop.detail: The AI can take or influence consequential actions with weak or no human approval. A single bad output can reach a customer directly.

partial_human_oversight.title: Partial human oversight
partial_human_oversight.detail: Only some outputs are checked. High-impact actions should require explicit human sign-off.

sensitive_data_exposure.title: Sensitive data exposure risk
sensitive_data_exposure.detail: Sensitive data is in scope. Residual privacy exposure remains.

sensitive_data_exposure_incomplete_pii.title: Sensitive data exposure risk
sensitive_data_exposure_incomplete_pii.detail: Sensitive data is processed and PII filtering appears incomplete. Output leakage risk is elevated.

sensitive_data_exposure_controls_present.title: Sensitive data exposure risk
sensitive_data_exposure_controls_present.detail: Sensitive data is in scope. Controls are present but residual privacy exposure remains.

prompt_injection_gaps.title: Prompt injection and AI-specific testing gaps
prompt_injection_gaps.detail: Guardrails and/or independent red-teaming are insufficient. Injection, jailbreaks, and unsafe answers may reach users.

high_advice_liability.title: High advice / decision liability
high_advice_liability.detail: Users may rely on AI output for decisions or advice. Hallucinations and confident errors create material E&O exposure.

no_audit_trail.title: No audit trail
no_audit_trail.detail: Without input/output logs, incidents cannot be reconstructed and claims are hard to defend.

weak_governance_docs.title: Weak AI governance documentation
weak_governance_docs.detail: No clear mapping to AI Act / GDPR / sector rules or approved AI policy. Regulatory exposure is under-documented.

prior_ai_loss.title: Prior AI-related loss or regulatory action
prior_ai_loss.detail: Material prior incidents indicate elevated frequency risk until remediation is evidenced.

strong_controls.title: Strong controls observed
strong_controls.detail: Oversight, logging, testing and governance are in place. Residual risk is limited to normal model uncertainty.

conditions.remediate_high_severity: Remediate high-severity findings before coverage is bound.
conditions.obtain_attestation: Obtain signed attestation before quoting or binding cover.
conditions.require_human_approval: Require human approval for all high-impact AI actions and regulated advice.
conditions.disable_autonomous: Disable unsupervised autonomous actions until control improvements are verified.
conditions.quarterly_red_team: Introduce quarterly red-team testing and re-assessment at renewal.
conditions.enable_logging: Enable full input/output logging with 12-month retention.
conditions.add_pii_filtering: Add PII input filtering and output scanning before binding.
conditions.complete_governance_docs: Complete AI governance documentation (policy + framework mapping) before binding cover.
conditions.provide_staging: Provide a staging endpoint for insurer-authorized testing within 30 days.
conditions.require_retest: Require re-test after any material model, prompt, or tool change.
conditions.incident_remediation: Provide incident remediation evidence before coverage is bound.
conditions.maintain_controls: Maintain current controls and re-assess at annual renewal.

systemStatus.title: Live system exposure
systemStatus.detail: The AI is {label}, so failures can create immediate claims exposure.

useCase.title: Elevated use-case risk
useCase.detail: Primary use case ({label}) carries above-average underwriting exposure.

useCase_agent.title: Autonomous agent use case
useCase_agent.detail: Workflow automation without tight bounds raises liability if the agent acts wrongly.

useCase_decisions.title: High-stakes decision support
useCase_decisions.detail: Credit, HR, claims or similar decisions create material errors-and-omissions exposure.

actionableAdvice.title: Users may rely on AI advice
actionableAdvice.detail: Actionable guidance creates advice and errors-and-omissions exposure if outputs are wrong.

autonomousActions.title: Unsupervised actions
autonomousActions.detail: The system can trigger actions without a human — payments, approvals, or access changes raise severity.

financialImpact.title: Material financial impact
financialImpact.detail: Worst-case loss if the AI fails is {label}, which sets claim severity.

nonFinancialImpact.title: Non-financial liability
nonFinancialImpact.detail: Main failure mode is {label} — a key driver of regulatory and reputation risk.

modelSource.title: Model / vendor complexity
modelSource.detail: Model sourcing ({label}) widens the control surface and vendor risk.

vendorContract.title: Weak contractual risk transfer
vendorContract.detail: AI liability and data-use terms are incomplete — harder to allocate loss at claim time.

dataSensitivity.title: Sensitive data in scope
dataSensitivity.detail: The system processes {label}, raising the cost of a leak or misuse.

dataHandling.title: Prompt and output handling
dataHandling.detail: {label} — storage, sharing, or training use increases privacy exposure.

piiFiltering.title: Incomplete PII controls
piiFiltering.detail: Personal data is not fully filtered on input and scanned on output — leakage risk remains open.

humanOversight.title: Limited human oversight
humanOversight.detail: Human review is only spot-checks — consequential mistakes can reach users unchecked.

humanOversight_never.title: Limited human oversight
humanOversight_never.detail: High-impact AI output is not reviewed by a human before action or regulated advice.

guardrails.title: Thin technical guardrails
guardrails.detail: Injection defenses, content filters, or access controls are incomplete — technical risk is elevated.

logging.title: Incomplete audit logging
logging.detail: Prompts, outputs, and tool calls are not fully logged — claims and incidents are harder to defend.

incidentResponse.title: No AI incident playbook
incidentResponse.detail: There is no documented response path for AI failures — slows containment and notification.

sandboxAccess.title: No insurer test access
sandboxAccess.detail: No staging endpoint for authorized testing — harder to verify controls without source code.

frameworks.title: Weak governance mapping
frameworks.detail: Limited mapping to AI Act / GDPR / sector rules — compliance posture is harder to evidence.

aiPolicy.title: No approved AI policy
aiPolicy.detail: Management has not approved a written AI governance policy — accountability is unclear.

qualityMeasurement.title: Weak quality monitoring
qualityMeasurement.detail: Output quality and known failure modes are not measured systematically — accuracy risk stays open.

retestOnChange.title: Change control gaps
retestOnChange.detail: The system is not always re-tested after model, prompt, or tool changes — silent risk drift between renewals.

priorIncidents.title: Prior AI-related issues
priorIncidents.detail: Prior minor or remediated AI issues — history still informs appetite and terms.

priorIncidents_yes.title: Prior AI-related issues
priorIncidents_yes.detail: Material prior loss, dispute, or regulatory action — a direct underwriting signal.

existingCover.title: Coverage overlap unclear
existingCover.detail: Existing cyber / E&O / PI may exclude AI or leave gaps — check stacking and exclusions.

redTeamed.title: Limited red-team evidence
redTeamed.detail: Red-team evidence is outdated — controls may have drifted since the last test.

redTeamed_no.title: Limited red-team evidence
redTeamed_no.detail: No recent adversarial testing — control effectiveness is largely unproven.

userDisclosure.title: Users may not know it is AI
userDisclosure.detail: Incomplete disclosure that content is AI-generated weakens transparency and consumer-duty posture.

attestation.title: Disclosure not attested
attestation.detail: The applicant has not attested to accuracy — underwriting should not rely on unchecked answers.

prompt_injection.title: Failed prompt-injection tests
prompt_injection.detail: Red-team probes bypassed guardrails — uncontrolled behaviour and liability exposure.

jailbreak.title: Failed jailbreak tests
jailbreak.detail: The system accepted policy overrides in testing — safety controls did not hold.

pii_leakage.title: PII leakage in testing
pii_leakage.detail: Test responses exposed personal data — privacy and breach cost exposure.

unsafe_advice.title: Unsafe advice in testing
unsafe_advice.detail: The model gave harmful or unauthorised recommendations under probe — E&O exposure.

unauthorized_action.title: Unauthorized actions in testing
unauthorized_action.detail: Probes showed high-impact actions without adequate human control.

hallucination.title: Hallucinations under test
hallucination.detail: Confident false answers in testing create errors-and-omissions exposure.

bias_discrimination.title: Bias findings in testing
bias_discrimination.detail: Unfair or discriminatory outputs under probe — fairness and compliance risk.

system_data_exfiltration.title: System data exposed in testing
system_data_exfiltration.detail: Hidden context, tools, or internal docs leaked under probe — aids attackers.
